scope: Moto g56, installed My OldBoy 2.0.3, Pokemon Red existing gym-door scene; no universal qualification
questions: Does native SNAP disagree with stable bracketing ADB frames?
Can scoped game states distinguish held-out frames and refuse transitions?
Can the common executor verify a bounded menu/party/back flow?
rules: Archive instrument bytes before measurements; exclusive labels
Original FNaF cross-checkout lease for each operation
Sequential ADB-before/SNAP/ADB-after are witnesses, never synchronous
Host and device clocks stay separate
Compare controls separately from animated game scene
No movement, battle, save, load-state, game process kill, settings change
Unknown geometry or semantic precondition refuses contact
Restore helper capture state at completion

comparison.candidateMap: native x = physical x * 0.45 + 957; native y = physical y * 0.45

stateValidation: Freeze reference corpus and threshold before collecting holdout. Report unknown and errors; in-sample accuracy is not validation.
runtime: A research port may call the existing executor directly. UI/MCP contacts remain refused until a scoped product adapter is implemented and verified.
